description: Use when the user asks which fonts a site uses or wants to match its typography: every @font-face file with family/weight/style/format, Google Fonts links and preloads, grouped per family in `families` (pass fields='families' for just that). On a type-foundry site the families served are demo cuts (subset, features stripped), flagged demo:true with a note - pass that on, they are not the usable typeface. Not for: colors (use extract_brand) or code (use extract_code).

fresh.description: Skip the 24-hour cache and re-extract the live page - use when the site just changed and a cached result would be stale. Charged normally; the fresh result replaces the cached copy.

render.description: Run the page in a real browser first so its JavaScript executes - use for client-rendered (React/Next/SPA) sites, when a normal call came back thin, or after a 403 target_blocked (bot protection refuses plain HTTP requests but usually lets a browser through). Slower, and adds 5 credits to the call. Paid API plans and credit packs only: on a free account it returns 402 render_requires_plan and nothing runs - never pass it as a first attempt, and when a free account gets that error, retry without it and tell the user this page needs JS rendering, a paid feature. Free accounts still get rendering automatically when the SITE refuses the plain request (401/403/406): the server retries it in a browser at no charge, a few times a month, and the result carries usage.renderRescue explaining what happened - read that sentence out to the user when it appears.

screenshot.description: Requires render=true. Adds a screenshot field to the result: a public URL of a capture of the page (live 7 days), taken by the same browser that rendered it. Pass true for the 1440x900 viewport or 'full' for the entire page height. No extra credits beyond the render surcharge. Useful for showing the user what the extracted site looks like.

name: extract_fonts

families.description: Grouped per-family summary - what most callers want

demo.description: The family name marks it a foundry demo/trial cut, not the real font

url.description: The font file or stylesheet URL

note.description: Only present when demo/trial families were found - tell the user, these files are subset and feature-stripped, not the usable typeface

truncation_note.description: Present when the result was trimmed - says what was dropped and how to get more.

usage.description: Credit usage for the authed key (spent, remaining, monthly limit).
